title: Philip Corso sees a Roswell body at Fort Riley

tellings.quote: opened up with the caskets and he saw the body from the Roswell.

plain: An Army officer named Philip J. Corso said that in 1947 at Fort Riley, an Army base in Kansas, he opened up the caskets that had been shipped there and saw a body from Roswell, the New Mexico site of a reported crashed craft. The documentary filmmaker James Fox relays this from Corso's book The Day After Roswell. If true, it would mean the military recovered non-human bodies from that crash.
